title: NPE in cleanupWriteBuffer() when closing Channel
body:
I am using Netty 3.5.10 and am closing a Channel with
    public static void close(Channel channel) {
        if (channel != null) {
            LOG.trace("Closing channel: {}", channel);
            channel.close().awaitUninterruptibly();
        }
    }

And I get this NPE in Netty code.
